name: Stymphalos
text: Stymphalus or Stymphalos (Greek: Στύμφαλος) was a town in the northeast of ancient Arcadia.

depictions.name: Stymphalos
depictions.text: Stymphalus (Arcadia) Stymphalos (Greek: Στύμφαλος) was a village and a small polis of ancient Greece, located by Lake Stymphalia. In classical antiquity it was located in the Golden Fields region of Arkadia.
